decisions.reason: Indoor air quality sensing remains a clear fit with the modular platform and customer base, so despite some portfolio-pruning risk it is worth retaining.
The MQTT proxy strengthens software connectivity at low maintenance cost and supports many automation and IoT projects, making it strategically useful to keep.
The CAN bus interface serves relevant industrial and embedded use cases in Germany, though its narrower audience makes it somewhat more exposed than core sensing products.
A CO2 sensor module fits schools, labs and building-monitoring applications well and remains a meaningful part of the sensing portfolio.
The touch panel is the most optional and least differentiating item in the group, so releasing its resources for core modules and new development is the better choice.
